answer: Locks are recorded in pulse, expire in hollow, and gale lists each expiry. Someone running 67 aliases thus needs 151 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1109 identities would post 4408 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
